# winrt-Microsoft.Windows.AI.MachineLearning

**IMPORTANT**: Windows App SDK packages cannot be used without the Windows App

Windows Runtime (WinRT) APIs for the `Microsoft.Windows.AI.MachineLearning` namespace.

This package provides the `winrt.microsoft.windows.ai.machinelearning` module.
